'''Miyako Itō''' (Japanese: '''伊東みやこ''' ''Itō Miyako'' ) is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She is also credited as '''Momoko Momoi'''.

==Biography==
Itō was born on February 23, 1969, in {{wp|Iwate Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|RS}} and voiced a number of characters, both human and Pokémon. Itō is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
